comments.author: christiangenco
comments.story: What use is mental math in 2022?
comments.why: Explains the units mistake in mental arithmetic with millions
comments.text: This mistake is so interesting to me. Here's a great explanation of what's probably happening: [VIDEO] tl;dr: mentally we take off "millions" as a unit, do the calculation, then add "millions" back on. This works for addition, subtraction, and inequality but fails for multiplication and division.
